notes.summary: ChatLocale gained required keys in 0.17.1. A hand-written full ChatLocale object no longer compiles and misses texts until it has them. Partial<ChatLocale> overrides are unaffected.
notes.howTo: Add these keys to every full ChatLocale object: activityDeclinedLabel, approvalSeenIdNote. English and German defaults ship with the SDK; the locale and locales props of AiChatProvider take Partial<ChatLocale>, so partial tables need no change.

notes.summary: ActivityStepStatus gained 'declined' (a declined approval, no longer 'error') and ApprovalSubject.status gained 'seen' with an optional fallback. An exhaustive switch or Record over either type no longer compiles.
notes.howTo: Add a case for 'declined' to every exhaustive switch or Record<ActivityStepStatus, ...> (show it neutrally, not as failed) and for 'seen' to a custom approval card's switch over ApprovalSubject.status (show it without a warning, with fallback as the label). The model now gets a fixed server text for a declined approval instead of the reason the browser sent.
